essence: One should be measured in speech and gentle in smile, especially in the presence of the venerable.
A vigilant and far-sighted person should carefully examine sense contacts.
One should act with striving and deliberate effort.
One should be devoted to the welfare of those two.
One should avoid self-exaltation and the censure of others.
